title: Transaction Summarizer
prompt: Implement summarize(transactions) — each item is a dict with 'category' and 'amount'. Return a list of (category, total) tuples counting ONLY positive amounts, sorted by total descending; ties broken alphabetically by category.

tests.name: aggregates positive amounts only
tests.hint: Skip negative amounts, then sum per category.

tests.name: ties are alphabetical
tests.hint: Sort key should be (-total, category) or two passes.
